1.

The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Deoghar Town P.S. Case No.489 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoghar, has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Deoghar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that it is a case under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code, the maximum sentence for which is up to 7 years as well as keeping in view the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of "Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar & Another reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273" , particularly paragraph no.12 of the same, followed by the judgement rendered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of "Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr." reported in 2022 (10) SCC 51 as well as the observation made in the case of "Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Dhiraj Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .......... Opp. ... on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118928281/
1 Investigation & Anr." reported in 2024 (9) SCC 198, without commenting on the merit of the present case, the petitioner is directed to appear and seek regular bail before the concerned Trial Court within three weeks, which shall be disposed of by the said Court in strict compliance of the guidelines laid down in the aforesaid cases.
